fields.Name: T61 - Entity Form Required Field Validation
fields.Description: Verifies that the Member entity form enforces required-field validation, blocking a save when a clearly-required field is left blank.

InputDefinition.goal: IMPORTANT: To open the 'Members' entity, use the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box — type 'Members' and click the node named EXACTLY 'Members' (individual member people, ~2000 records; NOT 'Board Members', 'Campaign Members', 'Member Follows', 'Memberships', 'Membership Types', 'Chapter Memberships', or 'Committee Memberships'). Do NOT fight a group expand-chevron. Navigate to Data Explorer, open the 'Members' entity, and click the New Record button to start creating a new member. Leave a clearly-required field (such as Email or Last Name) blank and attempt to click Save. Reach the state where the form blocks the save and surfaces a validation error or required-field indicator instead of saving the record. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for loads to finish rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A new member form was opened with a required field (such as Email or Last Name) left blank
An attempted save was blocked and a validation error message or required-field indicator is visible
The record was NOT silently saved as valid, and there are no crash pages or blank screens
